is_anopheles.evidence: Studies Anopheles coluzzii (and An. gambiae s.l.) across Ghana and neighboring West African countries (Page 1, Abstract; Page 4, 'Mosquito sampling and identification').

reports_target_markers.evidence: Reports frequencies in Figure 5 and Figure 6 for Vgsc L995F, Vgsc V402L, Vgsc I1527T, Vgsc N1570Y, Vgsc P1874S, Rdl A296S, Rdl A296G, Ace-1 G280S, Ace-1 CNV (AGAP001356 amp), and Cyp6aa1 CNV (AGAP002862 amp).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Figure 5 and Figure 6 display exact allele/CNV percentage frequencies across eight An. coluzzii cohorts from Ghana, with corresponding cohort sample sizes explicitly provided in Table 1 (e.g., Upper East Region: 2016 n=204, 2017 n=557, 2018 n=563).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were caught using human landing catches, CDC light traps, and indoor pyrethroid spray catches in field locations in Ghana (Navrongo in Kassena-Nankana districts, Upper East Region, collected 2016-2018) (Page 3-4).

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary research study presenting newly sequenced whole genomes for 1,324 An. coluzzii field specimens from Ghana alongside previously available genomic data (Page 4, Table 1; Page 6, 'Population sampling').

sub_country_location.evidence: Coordinates and specific district/regional names are reported in Table 1 and Methods (e.g., Navrongo, Kassena-Nankana districts, Upper East Region: 10.85, -1.11; Adansi, Ashanti Region; Madina, Greater Accra).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Populations are separated by single collection years: 2012, 2016, 2017, and 2018 (Table 1, Figure 5, Figure 6).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study analyzes 1,324 newly sequenced samples from Upper East Ghana deposited under MalariaGEN Vector Observatory / ENA PRJEB2141, and directly re-analyzes samples from AG1000G Phase 3 and Lucas et al. 2023 (Table 1).

supplement.evidence: Figure 5, Figure 6, and Table 1 in the main text provide the complete extractable marker frequencies and cohort sample sizes.

assessment.summary: This study analyzes genomic population structure and molecular insecticide resistance mechanisms across 1,810 An. coluzzii from Ghana (including 1,324 newly sequenced field samples from Navrongo collected 2016-2018 and previously sequenced cohorts from southern Ghana). Target-site marker frequencies (Vgsc L995F, V402L, I1527T, N1570Y, P1874S; Rdl A296G/S; Ace-1 G280S) and CNVs (Ace-1, Cyp6aa1, Cyp9k1, Gste2) are detailed across northern and southern bioclimatic zones.
